ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a bimodal distribution; high-intensity white pixels dominate the central surface area (approx. 65%), while low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edges and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white zones. Low-intensity black stippling and mottling are concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary. A prominent dark vertical column of pixels extends from the base through the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch visible with an estimated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees; depth is moderate relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations detected along the trailing edges; pixel-amplitude peaks are particularly dense on the distal thirds of both lobes, resulting in a jagged, irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure exhibiting a sweep that transitions from concave at the median notch to convex along the mid-section, ending in sharp, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized, high-intensity circular and ovoid pixel groups (likely barnacle colonization) are clearly visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like markings) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serrations and minor notches along the trailing edge indicative of historical tissue loss; prominent clusters of encrusting organisms on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific dense, vertical black stippled streak is located on the inner portion of the left lobe; concentrated black stippling forms a high-contrast 'fringe' along the right lobe trailing edge.
